questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT a key dimension of AI governance?
questions.explanation:
文中明确列出AI治理的四个关键维度：accountability（问责）、transparency（透明）、fairness（公平）、safety（安全）。Profitability（盈利性）未被提及。

押题理由: AI Governance是2026年全球热点话题，英语阅读极大概率选此主题。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷5#1

questions.stem: The EU AI Act adopts a（）approach to regulate artificial intelligence.
questions.explanation:
原文明确指出"It adopts a risk-based approach"，即基于风险的方法。

押题理由: EU AI Act是2025年生效的里程碑法规，英语阅读材料的理想来源。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷5#2

questions.stem: According to the passage, high-risk AI systems include those used in all of the following EXCEPT（）.
questions.explanation:
原文列出高风险AI系统应用领域包括"critical infrastructure, education, and employment"。Entertainment（娱乐）未被提及。

押题理由: 高风险AI系统分类是AI治理的核心知识点。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷5#3

questions.stem: The concept of "responsible AI" as described in the passage（）.
options: Is limited to legal compliance only
Extends beyond compliance to include ethical considerations
Applies only to high-risk AI systems
questions.explanation:
原文最后一句"The concept of responsible AI extends beyond mere compliance to embrace ethical considerations"，即负责任AI超越了单纯的合规要求，包含伦理考量。

押题理由: Responsible AI是AI治理的核心概念，理解其内涵对架构师至关重要。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷5#4
